capability: Resolve and read-only self-test one fixed bounded update-source registry through complete catalog and newest-package admission, with durable pin and anti-rollback
searchEvidence: VersionManagementExperience is the existing Application source-selection and package-admission owner; IUpdateCatalogSource and IManagedVersionRepository are the existing catalog/package ports; JsonVersionManagerStateStore and its exact state-path lease are the only durable writer
No existing fixed registry schema, reader, resolver, manual registry pin/resume, or revision-plus-digest anti-rollback owner was found
semanticOwner: VersionManagementExperience over one IUpdateSourceRegistry read port and the existing catalog, package, state-store, and exact state-path writer-lease ports
terminalContract: Infrastructure returns one strict bounded immutable registry snapshot or one typed failure and never chooses a source. Application tries exactly one latest then available entries in declared array order, never automatically selects deprecated, verifies the complete catalog and newest package, and commits effective source plus revision/digest/pin atomically only after lease reload and stable registry revalidation. Manual Browse is a durable pin until explicit successful Resume. The environment self-test reuses the same candidate admission for ordered latest/available reporting without writer acquisition, state/session/current mutation, selection, install, or delete. Rollback, same-revision conflict, all-candidate failure, stale generation, registry change, lease failure, save failure, and self-test cancellation preserve all durable state and installed inventory.

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 admission approved the amended ADR 0053 dependency direction and same-file/same-lease state design. Production implementation was admitted only with complete ordered structural catalog equality, exact double registry/catalog/Versions[0] package admission, revision-zero/effective-source invariants, strict component-wise filesystem reading, ADR 0056 logical mutation fencing, stale-state and writer evidence, and zero-mutation failures.
